01 / The challenge

The challenge for pest control.

Pest control is a sector where some customers want discretion and others want to see a professional van arrive. Many firms choose clean, reassuring branding that avoids pictures of pests.

01

Discretion

Some customers do not want neighbours to see a pest control van outside.

02

Looking professional

Commercial clients want reassurance that you are accredited.

03

Domestic and commercial

Restaurants, farms and homes all have different needs.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Business name
  • Pest control and prevention
  • Phone number
  • BPCA membership, if held

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Avoid pictures of pests

Most customers prefer a clean, professional look.

02

Consider a discreet option

Small, subtle branding for domestic call-outs, bolder branding for commercial work.

03

Show your accreditation

Trade body logos reassure commercial customers.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you make the van discreet?

Yes. We can design a subtle version with a small logo and contact details.

Should I use images of pests?

Usually not. A clean, reassuring design tends to work better.

Can I add my trade body logo?

Yes. Supply the official artwork and we will place it clearly.
